segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין בֵּין זָב הָרוֹאֶה שְׁתֵּי רְאִיּוֹת לָרוֹאֶה שָׁלֹשׁ אֶלָּא קׇרְבָּן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The difference between a zav who experiences two emissions» of a pus-like discharge from his penis «and one who experiences three» emissions «is only» that the zav who experienced three emissions is obligated to bring «an offering» after he recovers, in order to complete his purification process.
